tickets.title: Make backend compilation a required gate
tickets.delivery: Expose and repair the backend compiler failures so the advertised local and CI checks verify the whole application.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh root and standalone backend compilation pass without weakened strictness or excluded production code.
Production, seed and test diagnostics are corrected and existing tests still pass.
The finite check is part of the documented workspace and CI gate.

tickets.title: Close cross-organization batch and job reads
tickets.delivery: Authorized staff can read media, loan metadata, import diagnostics and relationships without any foreign-organization disclosure.
acceptanceCriteria: Authorize every actual referenced or returned record, including foreign IDs in every batch position.
Anonymous, nonmember and wrong-role callers receive no foreign URLs or diagnostic content.
Valid same-organization batches and job polling retain usable results and recovery states.

tickets.title: Validate related records and retain bulk movement evidence
tickets.delivery: Object, attachment and operational edits reject foreign or invalid references, and bulk/exhibition internal moves leave accountable history.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate referenced entities, destinations and blob ownership at write or delayed execution time.
Valid bulk and exhibition internal location changes record observed source, actor and reason; invalid destinations leave no partial writes.
Selectors and conflict/partial-job feedback work, and legacy invalid references are reported without invented repairs.

tickets.title: Publish only explicitly approved image renditions
tickets.delivery: Staff approve individual eligible images and preview public renditions while operational files and originals remain private.
acceptanceCriteria: Approval, preview, unpublish and version/rights invalidation work with scoped permissions.
All anonymous public detail/list/thumbnail/download responses fail closed for restricted, unknown-rights, unapproved or missing-rendition files.
Legacy attachments default private without deletion; original downloads have a separate explicit policy and historical URL exposure is assessed at rollout.

tickets.title: Withdraw and restore museum object records
tickets.delivery: Authorized staff archive an object with a reason and restore it with its permanent identity and linked evidence intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Routine and archive views, reason capture, register access and restore controls have functioning backend and permissions.
Withdrawal and restore retain identifiers, attachments and related accession/disposal/care/custody evidence.
Dependency conflicts and unavailable legacy evidence are explicit; no guessed repair or hard-delete fallback is offered.

tickets.title: Protect permanent evidence from every cleanup path
tickets.delivery: Register, treatment, file and organization cleanup cannot bypass museum evidence retention.
acceptanceCriteria: Guard direct and indirect destruction of permanent register, movement, condition, appraisal, treatment and documentary evidence.
Organization cleanup and orphan-file handling retain evidentiary references; unsupported purge controls are removed.
Legacy cleanup is additive/rerunnable and retention regression fixtures preserve counts, IDs and relationships.

tickets.title: Register devices and receive authenticated environmental readings
tickets.delivery: Staff manage scoped device credentials and receive deduplicated temperature/humidity readings with trustworthy timestamps and health status.
acceptanceCriteria: Registration, one-time credential display, binding, rotation/revocation and last-seen/error UI work end to end.
HTTP ingestion validates device/probe, tenant/location, units, timestamp, rate limits and stable reading identity; retries create one reading and logical alert contribution.
Anonymous, revoked, malformed and wrong-location submissions make no writes; manual staff readings remain authorized and audited.

tickets.title: Verify Tuya forwarding and safe sender cutover
tickets.delivery: A selected Tuya gateway/cloud adapter forwards verified normalized measurements without interrupting any existing monitoring.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolve the actual model, gateway/cloud transport, payload units/scaling, message identity and upstream authentication before implementation/cutover.
Verify upstream messages and bind each probe before forwarding; replay, delayed packets, revocation and disconnects have demonstrable outcomes.
Prove selected-device forwarding before advertising Tuya connectivity or disabling a real old sender; secrets are not exposed and insecure rollback is prohibited.

tickets.title: Apply preserved identifier policy to catalog and accession
tickets.delivery: Staff assign and find stable institutional identifiers under an explicit uniqueness policy without rewriting historical register numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate the accepted register/organization identifier policy across direct catalog and accession numbering paths.
Normalize searchable identifiers additively and surface reviewed legacy conflicts without auto-renumbering or deletion.
Authorized forms show actionable duplicate/conflict results, and concurrent assignments cannot violate the policy.

tickets.title: Make accession import retries and progress safe
tickets.delivery: An accession import can be retried, resumed and corrected without duplicate register records or misleading progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Persist stable job/source-row results and return the stored result on replay.
Track attempted/accepted/failed outcomes through terminal states, cancellation and resumed correction with usable row errors.
Use shared validated parsers, bounded processing and scoped polling; replay and interruption retain one intended accession per accepted row.

tickets.title: Make remaining structured imports resumable
tickets.delivery: Every other supported structured import follows the same safe row-outcome and correction contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory supported object and operational import types and implement complete replay-safe behavior for each existing advertised type.
Date, status, reference and numbering validation preserves uncertainty instead of guessing values.
Mapping, validation, failed-row correction and progress UI round-trip accepted data; unsupported types are not advertised.

tickets.title: Make media imports resumable and ownership-safe
tickets.delivery: Media import interruption and retry retain one authorized attachment outcome per source item with honest progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Reuse durable item outcomes for mapping, upload/link completion and retries without duplicate attachments.
Validate upload ownership and object context, retain originals and report failed file outcomes safely.
Import UI supports resume/cancel/error recovery; credential and foreign-file cases are refused.

tickets.title: Complete draft-to-verified-accession intake
tickets.delivery: Staff capture one resumable draft, satisfy source policy, approve accession and continue cataloguing without repeated entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared draft/catalog field contracts preserve every accepted field, including specialized metadata, through publication.
Draft and existing-object accessions obey the same backend source/approval rules; authorized exceptions retain reasons.
Validation, save/recovery, review and resulting object/register links are functional and preserve one object identity.

tickets.title: Enforce stage-specific disposal decisions
tickets.delivery: Staff approve disposal and record later exit/proceeds evidence at the proper stages under institutional policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree method-specific decision/exit/proceeds requirements and enforce every approval path.
Show blocking checklist and authorized audited exceptions; do not require a future sale receipt before decision authorization.
Legacy decisions and evidence remain retained and distinguished, with no retrospective invented compliance.

tickets.title: Return correct scoped identifier search results
tickets.delivery: Catalog/global search finds actual normalized identifier or descriptive matches rather than unrelated lexical successors.
acceptanceCriteria: Use genuine prefix boundaries or appropriate indexed text search with explicit scope/ranking.
Foreign and unauthorized records are absent; missing/no-match and filter behavior is consistent.
Direct, global and relevant entity search callers remain functional with representative identifier/text fixtures.

tickets.title: Make work queues and object selectors complete
tickets.delivery: Staff can reach every matching accession and selectable object with complete server filtering and truthful totals.
acceptanceCriteria: Paginate beyond the first hundred queue entries and display total versus loaded counts accurately.
Search-on-demand selectors reach objects beyond the old five-thousand cap without draining whole organizations.
Filtering, pagination, loading, errors and selection recovery retain user context and authorization.

tickets.title: Capture retained object condition assessments
tickets.delivery: Staff create dated evidence-backed assessments and review a current-condition projection without overwriting previous checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Assessment capture, assessor/date, structured observations, photos and acceptance permissions work from object details.
Retain original condition histories/evidence and support explicit uncertain legacy states.
Accepted assessment updates current condition transactionally while immutable history and comparison remain accessible.

tickets.title: Execute guarded movements and delayed requests
tickets.delivery: Direct and approval-based internal moves record observed custody/location and refuse stale-source or occupancy conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: One guarded command records actor, observed source, destination, time, reason and case alongside current projection.
Delayed requests revalidate source, destination access and current loan/custody occupancy at execution.
Request/approve/execute/conflict UI works with permanent retained history; ordinary/bulk movement behavior remains consistent.

tickets.title: Complete per-item loan dispatch and returns
tickets.delivery: Registrars dispatch and partially or fully receive loan items with explicit condition and destination, including incoming lender exits.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain origin and distinct outgoing/incoming assessment links; item dispatch/return state is independent of condition text.
Receipt confirms destination and evidence, reconciles parent/outstanding items and releases occupancy correctly.
Incoming return creates recorded exit to lender, not new synthetic deaccession; legacy unknowns and assertions remain preserved.

tickets.title: Make exhibition participation authoritative
tickets.delivery: An exhibition has one complete many-object participant list instead of competing anchor and member records.
acceptanceCriteria: Expand canonical participation and migrate all affected exhibition readers/writers with compatible historical records.
Many-object creation, member roles/order, filters and counts work with scoped permissions.
Retire competing writer/field semantics only after parity and legacy-member review are proven.

tickets.title: Make collection group membership authoritative
tickets.delivery: Staff manage clearly defined primary and secondary collection memberships without contradictory associations.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree primary-role semantics and maintain one authoritative membership relation with protected references.
Group selection, object editing, counts, transfers and supported import/export paths use the canonical relation.
Backfill additively and retire duplicated semantics only after reader/writer parity; retain original evidence of ambiguous memberships.

tickets.title: Confirm exhibition installation and physical returns
tickets.delivery: Staff install, deinstall and receive each exhibition object with movement/condition evidence before closing the case.
acceptanceCriteria: Each physical handoff records assessment and movement/custody using the shared commands.
Closure requires confirmed item outcomes or authorized documented exceptions, without automatically inventing return.
Participant actions, outstanding items, conflicts and complete event timeline are usable for permitted staff.

tickets.title: Record accountable shipment receipt and installation handoffs
tickets.delivery: Transport arrival, acceptance and installation update their linked loan/exhibition cases only from recorded handoffs.
acceptanceCriteria: Shipment arrival does not itself attest accepted custody, installation or object return.
Per-item receipt links responsible actor, observed destination and condition evidence through the shared movement contract.
Transit/installation actions, task progress and related cases agree under retry, partial arrival and wrong-role tests.

tickets.title: Complete conservation with assessment evidence
tickets.delivery: Conservators link treatment to baseline and outcome assessments and create accountable follow-up work.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan/authorize/complete treatment retains original documents and baseline assessment.
Completion requires the institution-defined outcome assessment and updates current condition only from accepted evidence.
Treatment UI, comparison and follow-up status work with proper roles and recoverable failures.

tickets.title: Retain evidence through institution transfer
tickets.delivery: An authorized two-party object transfer retains accountable custody and institutional evidence rather than bypassing movement rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve two-party authorization and transfer eligibility while recording observed custody/location and retained identity.
Mapped destination, links and access follow explicit transfer policy without silent evidence/file loss.
Transfer review/acceptance/conflict UI and legacy/history views remain consistent and reject unauthorized or replayed changes.

tickets.title: Retrieve complete stable audit history
tickets.delivery: Auditors retrieve years of filtered evidence with stable actor/subject meaning and correlated object/case timelines.
acceptanceCriteria: Indexed cursor queries reach beyond the latest thousand events and label counts honestly.
Actor/subject snapshots, immutable corrections and growing historical child records preserve original content/order.
Date filters, detail/diffs, correlations and authorized history export have working recovery and pagination.

tickets.title: Run honest timezone-aware KPI schedules
tickets.delivery: Staff run supported real KPI reports at intended local times and see unsupported or failed output truthfully.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported generator produces usable stored output; legacy unsupported types cannot be marked successful.
Schedule identity, timezone/DST/month boundaries and controlled-clock retries produce correct runs.
UI distinguishes generated/stored/delivered/unavailable results and does not advertise an unimplemented email channel.

tickets.title: Align operational metrics and drill-downs
tickets.delivery: Dashboard, listing and report metrics use one defined lifecycle/schedule meaning and matching drill-down filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree active/current/upcoming/past and inventory/loan exclusions with explicit as-of time.
Review legacy flags and contradictory counters rather than silently inventing states.
Overview, analytics and list links show consistent definitions/count scope, including missing versus zero values.

tickets.title: Produce bounded complete export artifacts
tickets.delivery: Staff export large authorized selections through resumable jobs and download complete typed artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Use bounded continuations, progress/cancel/resume, safe retry and scoped artifact access.
Typed columns preserve date/number/text semantics; defined CSV handling prevents formula interpretation without header-name guessing.
Filters/as-of/version, counts and checksum reconciliation establish completeness and documented format compatibility.

tickets.title: Maintain and reconcile bounded projections
tickets.delivery: Large institutions receive bounded dashboard/report/usage queries and reviewable projection discrepancies.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintain aggregate/time buckets from agreed events and metric definitions, with bounded rebuild checkpoints.
All relevant writers update projections consistently; failed/replayed rebuilds are safe.
Measure synthetic small/large institutions and expose admin health/reconciliation outcomes without guessed historical repair.

tickets.title: Prove migration and backup recovery
tickets.delivery: An operator rehearses additive migration and restores records plus files on an isolated target with verifiable evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm target and recovery objectives, preserve original snapshot and rehearse rerunnable bounded migration.
Restore verifies IDs, counts, file/reference integrity and reconciled projections on a disposable nonproduction environment.
Runbook/status/rollback outcomes are concrete; missing access or failed evidence is disclosed and unsafe rollback is prohibited.

tickets.title: Reuse parties across institutional procedures
tickets.delivery: Staff select shared people/institutions in contextual roles while historical names remain preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Typed party/relationship links enforce existence, tenant and permissions across acquisition, loan, donor and appraisal contexts.
Reusable picker, role history and reviewed duplicate suggestions work without automatic identity merging.
Retain original named assertions/contact snapshots and provide actionable legacy-link review.

tickets.title: Record evidence-backed uncertain provenance
tickets.delivery: Researchers maintain dated provenance claims with source evidence, uncertainty and reviewed corrections.
acceptanceCriteria: Support partial/uncertain dates, anonymous historical parties and claim confidence without forced invented values.
Evidence and party roles link to the object with immutable original text/assertion provenance.
Capture, review and supersession UI work with scoped access and preserve contradictory historical claims for review.

tickets.title: Complete temporary entry and acquisition-to-exit journeys
tickets.delivery: Staff receipt temporary property, branch to acquisition/accession or return, and record recipient exit using one object identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Entry captures depositor/owner, purpose, temporary identifier, custody, condition, responsibility and due dates.
Acquisition/title evidence remains separate from possession and permanent accession policy.
Rejected acquisitions/deposits/incoming custody exit to a recorded recipient without fabricated deaccession; retained registers and existing loan flows agree.

tickets.title: Reconcile valuation and effective insurance coverage
tickets.delivery: Staff see purpose/currency/date appraisals and effective single-target coverage instead of ambiguous current values.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical purpose-specific appraisal and supersession preserve historical values and explain current projections.
Each coverage has one typed target and valid policy/date interval; multi-target legacy rows require reviewed reconciliation.
UI/alerts/totals distinguish gaps, expiry, purpose and currencies; no unsupported combined monetary total is shown.

tickets.title: Deliver institutional register reports and interchange
tickets.delivery: Staff generate real accession, disposal, custody and condition register outputs with documented exchange profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Profiles produce actual authorized artifacts with criteria/as-of/generator identity and complete retained evidence.
Document typed interchange encoding and validate representative round-trips, without an accreditation/compliance claim.
Preview/run/download/error UI works; missing historical facts remain explicit and unsupported profiles are unavailable.

tickets.title: Deliver financial and provenance report profiles
tickets.delivery: Staff generate reproducible financial/insurance and provenance reports with correct currency, validity and evidence meaning.
acceptanceCriteria: Use canonical appraisal, coverage and provenance datasets with explicit filters/as-of/version.
Expose real complete artifacts, currency-grouped totals and source/uncertainty information under scoped access.
Board/insurer/research outputs have working preview, progress, download and failure handling without stub success.

tickets.title: Align vocabulary navigation and capability policy
tickets.delivery: Staff encounter consistent museum terms and access reasons across sidebar, pages, settings and backend operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree glossary and independent organization/site/module/entitlement/role dimensions.
Canonical routes and capability matrix govern visibility and actual commands; optional library semantics remain intact.
Preserve current intentional customer access and pricing, explaining unavailable features rather than changing commercial policy implicitly.

tickets.title: Make operational forms resumable and recoverable
tickets.delivery: Staff complete operational forms with shared draft/field contracts, contextual validation and recoverable interruption.
acceptanceCriteria: Use accepted object/party contracts without retyping captured data or losing supported fields.
Save/dirty/conflict/validation and error recovery work across selected case and catalog forms.
Backend policy remains authoritative; schema/draft changes are versioned/additive and supported specialized/library forms regressions pass.

tickets.title: Preserve list context and detail recovery
tickets.delivery: Filtering, opening and returning to operational records preserves URL state and offers useful missing/forbidden/error recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Search/filter/sort/page and originating-list context survive reload/share/back navigation.
Distinguish loading, no data, no match, missing, forbidden, unavailable and stale conflicts with working actions.
Backend pagination/filter results and detail boundaries agree across representative queues and catalog lists.

tickets.title: Make shared operational controls keyboard-accessible
tickets.delivery: Staff complete representative table, filter, dialog and form tasks with semantic controls and predictable keyboard focus.
acceptanceCriteria: Use meaningful headers/labels/expanded states and reachable primary actions in shared controls.
Focus, dialog dismissal/error focus, selection and long-content overflow work in actual browser tasks.
Affected list/form consumers retain selection, authorization and recovery behavior without a blanket conformance claim.

tickets.title: Complete responsive field movement and receipt tasks
tickets.delivery: Technicians find, assess, move and receive objects on supported phones/tablets without inaccessible dense layouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify representative narrow phone, tablet and desktop tasks with long labels and touch/keyboard input.
Movement, condition and loan/exhibition receipt primary actions remain reachable with deliberate scrolling/stacking.
Loading/conflict/validation and return-to-context work on target devices, with actual browser evidence.

tickets.title: Complete operational terminology across locales
tickets.delivery: Staff receive consistent translated operational labels, errors and feedback across all registered locales.
acceptanceCriteria: Coordinate with existing localization work and scope this ticket to remaining terminology/workflow gaps rather than duplicate completed fixes.
Translate real validation/loading/empty/toast/approval strings with correct interpolation and date/number/currency policy.
Review long strings and complete changed task journeys in supported layouts; record explicit fallback behavior.

tickets.title: Review and repair documentation quality exceptions
tickets.delivery: Documentation officers run bounded completeness checks and assign reviewed repair work without inventing facts.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure profiles by object type/stage and surface duplicate identifiers, missing evidence, uncertain legacy links and orphan references.
Findings link to authorized repair context and preserve original values; no automatic renumber, merge or guessed history.
Site deletion validates active descendants/references, and reviewed backlog results use bounded jobs and capability policy.

tickets.title: Recover accounts without existence disclosure
tickets.delivery: Legitimate users can recover/sign in while public responses do not reveal password-account existence.
acceptanceCriteria: Review existing provider/client branching and replace durable public account-existence signals with neutral behavior.
Valid recovery/sign-in remains usable and abuse controls cover the surrounding auth flow.
Compare existing/nonexistent/password/other-provider cases at public boundary and UI without introducing account takeover or denial regressions.

tickets.title: Manage accountable case-linked work queues
tickets.delivery: Staff create and complete scoped case tasks with owners, due dates and blockers from one personal/review queue.
acceptanceCriteria: Typed case/task links validate referenced context and permission; assignments/dependencies cannot leak foreign data.
My work, review, case detail and blocker/completion actions function with retained evidence links.
Task completion does not attest physical custody, legal approval or condition improvement.

tickets.title: Inspect and retry durable outgoing webhooks
tickets.delivery: Integration administrators see real delivery attempts and safely replay failed outgoing events.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain stable event intent/payload version and bounded attempts with idempotency, backoff and terminal outcomes.
Existing signed authorized webhooks remain functional and payload visibility/replay is tenant-scoped.
Delivery log, fixture endpoint test and retry UI work; transient/permanent/revoked endpoint behavior is verified without real recipient messages.

tickets.title: Honor notification preferences and trace instant delivery
tickets.delivery: Recipients receive only permitted category/channel notifications and can inspect trustworthy bell/email outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: One preference-aware dispatcher controls all affected emitters and validates recipient/content access.
Instant email uses durable delivery state; disabled categories do not send and unsupported digest choices are not falsely advertised.
Notification center, settings and retry/error outcomes work with deduplication and fixture delivery.

tickets.title: Deliver real daily and weekly digests
tickets.delivery: Recipients choosing a digest receive one authorized grouped delivery on the intended schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: Offer daily/weekly choices only with a working scheduled worker and controlled-clock calendar tests.
Preferences, category exclusions, access changes and replay cannot duplicate or disclose digest contents.
Settings, delivery state and missed/retry recovery correspond to actual fixture email output.

tickets.title: Track sustained environmental alert episodes
tickets.delivery: Conservators see one actionable breach episode with updates and escalation rather than a new alert for every reading.
acceptanceCriteria: Use authenticated deduplicated observations with explicit late/out-of-order and threshold/recovery policies.
Open/update/recover/escalate an episode idempotently and honor category/channel preferences.
Monitoring/notification views show evidence, state and last-seen distinctions without interpreting disconnected devices as healthy.

tickets.title: Create preparation tasks from accepted case events
tickets.delivery: Accepted intake, loan and exhibition events create accountable next-step tasks and notifications once.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure evidence-aware recipes for catalog/photography/condition, packing/insurance/transport and return preparation.
Repeated/corrected events maintain one logical task intent with visible owner, dependency and case context.
Suggestions are reviewable/reversible and never automatically assert physical receipt, installation, title or condition.

tickets.title: Verify inventory with scanning labels and exceptions
tickets.delivery: Field staff compare expected and observed objects/locations in scan sessions and review mismatches before reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: Session scope, labels/reprint, scan observations and expected-versus-observed progress work on supported devices.
Observations retain actor/time/evidence and do not automatically become custody transfers.
Exception review links to guarded authorized movement/repair, with safe retry and retained institutional history.

tickets.title: Capture inventory offline with explicit conflict review
tickets.delivery: Approved field devices retain secure inventory drafts offline and synchronize without silently overwriting authoritative records.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolve supported devices, encrypted local retention, revocation, observation identity and conflict policy before implementation.
Interrupted/repeated sync deduplicates observations and presents source changes for review.
Offline/online status, queue/error/conflict recovery and device data clearing have complete demonstrable behavior.

tickets.title: Coordinate incident and emergency collection response
tickets.delivery: Staff document damage/loss/emergency incidents and coordinate accountable response under approved institutional plans.
acceptanceCriteria: Link affected objects/locations, assessments/photos, custody, insurance and retained response evidence with scoped visibility.
Rapid intake, triage, assignment, plan-guided response and after-action records work through actual task and notification flows.
Sensitive incidents, repeated triggers and physical evacuation/recovery handoffs preserve authorization and evidence; no plan is invented by automation.

tickets.title: Complete research and reproduction requests
tickets.delivery: Staff take a request through rights/evidence review, approved terms and derivative delivery with retained use records.
acceptanceCriteria: Capture requester/purpose, rights evidence, decision, versioned terms/expiry and approved derivative without exposing private originals.
Request review, approved delivery and expiry/revocation outcomes are usable and permission-scoped.
Durable delivery and retry evidence is verifiable; optional metadata assistance is deferred until separately specified and never alters authoritative history.
